data.name: Crypts Of Carith
data.detailed_description:
Fight For Survival

The depths of Carith are filled with deadly creatures that demand careful strategy to defeat.

Command your party of six adventurers in tactical turn-based RPG combat where every action matters.

  • Strike enemies with melee and ranged weapons

  • Cast powerful spells to control the battlefield

  • Protect vulnerable allies with support abilities

  • Use your party’s strengths to overcome dangerous foes

Manage spell resources, status effects, and positioning as your party battles increasingly dangerous foes deeper in the crypts.

Don't forget to rest!

Start Your Adventure In The Unassuming Village Of Carith

What begins as a simple expedition soon becomes something far darker.

Beneath the quiet village streets lie forgotten catacombs, cursed chambers, and ancient secrets that were never meant to be uncovered.

Every descent pushes your party deeper into danger—and closer to the truth hidden below.

Manage your party and meet the townsfolk in Carith

Tread Lightly Into The Darkness

Each step could be your last as you descend into the depths of Carith's underbelly.

  • Interact with the world around you.

  • Venture into untouched chambers.

  • Search for secrets.

  • Navigate dangerous traps!

Light your path and descend into the darkness

Gather Your Party

Create a party of up to six custom adventurers and descend into the sacred Crypts of Carith, where long-buried evils are beginning to stir beneath the stone.

In the full version you will be able to use your own character portraits!

Build Your Strategy

Customize your party as you see fit, and swap characters out at any point.

  • Mix classes, skills, and species

  • Experiment with unusual party compositions

  • Take on the crypts your own way

From heavily armored warriors to fragile but powerful wizards, survival depends on how well your party works together.

A Familiar TTRPG System

Games in the EverMoore Chronicles are built on a familiar D20-style RPG system inspired by classic tabletop adventures, and the mechanics that shaped classic role-playing games, updated to work better as a videogame.

If you’ve played traditional D20 RPGs, the system will feel instantly familiar—while still offering plenty of depth for party building and strategy.

Focused Adventure

Each entry in the EverMoore Chronicles is designed as a complete, hand crafted RPG adventure.

Your characters are persistent and maintain all of their XP and Items and can be taken between adventures.

Key Features

  • Create a party of up to six adventurers
    Build your own group of warriors, rogues, clerics, and mages.

  • Explore the depths beneath Carith
    Venture through sewers, forgotten cellars, ancient tombs, and sacred crypts.

  • Classic dungeon crawling gameplay
    Fight dangerous creatures in turn-based combat, discover hidden secrets, and recover lost treasure.

  • Level up and grow stronger
    Earn experience, learn new spells and abilities, and equip powerful gear.

  • Familiar D20-based RPG system
    Inspired by traditional tabletop mechanics that reward strategy and party synergy.

  • Designed for replayability
    Try different party builds, unusual strategies, or challenge runs.

  • A focused RPG adventure
    A tightly designed campaign packed with exploration and combat.

Crypts of Carith is the first chapter in the EverMoore Chronicles—a series of standalone RPG adventures connected by a larger story unfolding across the world of Aurelith.

Each game explores a new region with its own mysteries, dangers, and discoveries.

Your characters are persistent and can carry forward between games, bringing their experience, equipment, and hard-earned victories with them.

Solo Developer

Crypts of Carith is being developed by EverMoore Studios, currently a solo developer project dedicated to reviving the spirit of classic dungeon-crawling RPGs.

Currently supported by additional 2D and Audio resources where funds allow.

Follow On Discord

Follow development and join the community on Discord.

data.short_description: Explore the village of Carith, dank sewers, forgotten cellars, and ancient tombs, battle deadly creatures, and uncover powerful loot in this classic party-based dungeon crawling RPG built on a familiar D20 system.
data.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB / AMD RX 580 (4GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10600K / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2070 / AMD RX 6700 XT (8GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
